title: Launch on Product Hunt
summary: Analytics and email capture on before launch day, assets ready, submitted to PH and the directories, the spike caught.

parts.title: Set up product analytics
parts.guidance: Define the launch questions that analytics should answer, such as which visitors complete the intended product action. Use the analytics workflow to implement and verify the required events with appropriate privacy controls. Record a pre-launch baseline and test the acquisition path so the launch team can distinguish usable measurement from raw traffic spikes.

parts.title: Set up email marketing
parts.guidance: Prepare the launch signup and follow-up path around what subscribers expect to receive. Configure the email workflow, review consent and suppression handling, and test delivery and unsubscribe behavior using controlled addresses. Obtain approval for the actual launch messages and audience, preserving signup context so later campaigns do not exceed the permission collected.

parts.title: Launch on Product Hunt & directories
parts.guidance: Choose the launch channels according to the product's current readiness and each community's rules. Follow the launch workflow to prepare truthful assets, a usable destination and a response owner before submission. Track submission links and outcomes, then use measured visits, product actions and feedback to assess each launch channel.
